document.abstract: WebDVD is the combination of two of the hottest technologies: DVD and the Internet. DVD makes up for the bandwidth limitations of the Internet, while a Web connection makes up for the static nature of DVD. This paper discusses features and advantages of Web-connected DVDs, how it all works, and what tools are available.
